reference.text: Below to thy nightly grave; where such as ye sleep between shrouds, to use ye to the filling one at last.—Down, dog, and kennel!”

reference.text: “No, sir; not yet,” said Stubb, emboldened, “I will not tamely be called a dog, sir.”
